<!-- Do not include anything private: no repo names of your own, no local paths, no knowledge base content. -->

**The problem**

What goes wrong today, and for whom. One real instance is worth more than a general case.

**The change**

What YBase would do differently. Name the files if you know them.

**Who it is true for**

YBase holds only what is true and harmless for every user. Say why this belongs in the framework and not in one user's knowledge base or one repo's own rules.

**Cost**

What it adds to always-on context, to setup, or to the checks every commit runs.
